target: same z affects function 1 and function 2
minimum_design: manipulate or measure one invariant z coordinate under both functions
positive_result: non-zero z response for both declared functions
main_alternative: different hidden coordinates or correlated traits drive the two functions

minimum_design: multi-level z crossed with selective P/G states
positive_result: z_P_star and z_G_star are separated with uncertainty incompatible with one common state optimum
main_alternative: one common state optimum or unresolved curvature
claim_ceiling: functional conflict on one shared coordinate; not pure z_F1_star/z_F2_star identification

target: combined optimum is displaced between or away from state-specific optima
minimum_design: multi-level z under P/G states plus common fitness
positive_result: z_C_star is a supported interior W11 optimum and differs from at least one state-specific optimum
main_alternative: intermediate phenotype caused by unmeasured process or monotonic endpoint

target: functional weights causally maintain the compromise
minimum_design: selectively weaken pollination and antagonism in separate treatments
positive_result: removing G shifts z_C_star toward z_P_star and removing P shifts z_C_star toward z_G_star
main_alternative: trait optimum fixed by non-focal costs or intervention contamination

target: opposing functions act on the same local z contrast
minimum_design: two-level z x function-1 access x function-2 access crossed design
positive_result: function-1 access makes the z effect more positive while function-2 access makes it less positive
main_alternative: only one function responds or interventions are not selective

minimum_design: heritability plus repeated selection or experimental evolution
positive_result: trait means/frequencies move predictably when functional weights are changed
main_alternative: phenotypic plasticity only or no response to selection

target: pure function-specific optima z_F1_star and z_F2_star are identified beyond state-specific reproductive optima
minimum_design: independent assay or restriction that identifies direct/background C(z) and isolates each functional objective
positive_result: pure z_F1_star/z_F2_star are estimable separately from z_P_star/z_G_star
main_alternative: state optima remain mixtures of focal and direct/background consequences

target: measured state-specific compromise creates an empirical target for added dimensionality
minimum_design: positive causal SCH receipt with z_P_star z_G_star z_C_star
positive_result: BITA can prospectively test movement of x_star toward z_P_star by default
main_alternative: added coordinate fails to release or worsens joint fitness

target: larger pure-function conflict creates greater ideal value of added dimensionality
minimum_design: independently identify z_F1_star z_F2_star local curvature/weights and architecture cost
positive_result: theoretical compromise penalty increases with pure optimum separation and joint functional strength
main_alternative: added architecture cost dominates or residual coupling prevents release
claim_ceiling: theory-level Delta_mod opportunity; not default empirical estimand
